design_philosophy.core_concept: A modern, Gen Z-focused Christian social platform fusing the raw, unfiltered feel of TikTok with the community utility of Eventbrite, styled in a playful neo-brutalist aesthetic with pastel colors and stark black borders.
design_philosophy.layout_strategy: Mobile-first feed architecture for the app, with bento-box asymmetry for the marketing landing page. High contrast, generous padding, and bold geometric separations.

background.description: Warm off-white (Butter) to avoid clinical pure white.

primary.description: Bubblegum Pink for primary CTAs and major highlights.

secondary.description: Lime/Neon Green for secondary actions, tags, or event RSVPs.

accent.description: Cyber Yellow and Soft Blue for alternating card backgrounds in the feed.

rules: No teal or purple for CTAs.
Never use pure black (#000000), use Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A).
Always pair pastel backgrounds with thick #0A0A0A borders.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Labels and overlines must be uppercase, tiny, and wide tracking.
Do NOT use Inter for headings.

cards.classes: bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#0A0A0A] transition-all hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#0A0A0A]
cards.usage: Use for feed testimonies, church profiles, and event listings. Alternate background colors (Pink, Yellow, Blue, Green, White) for different feed items to create a vibrant timeline.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but lean into generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside containers.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_page: Use 'Bento' grid (Tetris mode). A mix of large hero blocks and smaller supporting squares with gap-8. High visual tension.
layout_and_spacing.app_layout: Mobile-first. The main feed should be constrained to max-w-xl mx-auto on desktop. Sidebars for navigation and suggested churches on desktop.
rules: Grid items must be direct children.
Images on mobile must not exceed 80vh.
No centered text on large paragraphs; left-align everything except maybe the hero headline.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React with strokeWidth={2.5} to match the chunky neo-brutalist aesthetic.

marketing_hero.description: Diverse group of friends taking a selfie together - great for the 'community' vibe on the landing page.

community_gathering.description: Three smiling young men standing together - use in about/community sections.

event_worship.description: Crowd with hands raised - use as thumbnail for event listings (concerts, worship nights).

church_profile.description: Modern building - use as placeholder for church cover photos.

media.rules: Never use generic placeholders. Only use provided URLs.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Always scale up or translate-x/y to simulate tactile buttons pressing down or popping up.
motion_and_interactions.feed: Animate new posts/testimonies entering the feed with a spring animation (framer-motion `type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20`).
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee on the marketing page to scroll words like 'CONNECT • WORSHIP • SHARE • DISCOVER' in large uppercase font with a thick border stroke.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='feed-post-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a combined platform: Marketing landing page at '/' and the App feed at '/app'.
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (stagger children in the feed).
Customize Shadcn components heavily to remove the default 'Vercel' look—replace subtle borders with thick 2px black borders and sharp shadows.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The app feed should feel native on mobile (bottom nav) but scale elegantly on desktop (sidebar + constrained center feed).
Use Lucide icons with a thicker stroke to match the typography weight.
Do NOT use pure black, use #0A0A0A.
Implement the testimonies feed like a scrolling list of high-contrast cards. Include image/video placeholders using the provided URLs.
